description.narrative: Project-level outcomes are: (i) increased employment and value addition in Serbias and Polands economies through the near-shoring of a strategic automotive component for the transition to sustainable mobility, and (ii) the upskilling of the workforce in advanced manufacturing technologies. Beyond the Project, IFC expects the investment to: (i) fast-track significant improvements in the resilience of the European EV ecosystem, by helping near-shore the production of a critical component in EV battery systems, and lowering reliance on a few global suppliers, and (ii) to unlock high gains in economic complexity, in particular for Serbia.

The proposed IFC investment will support Minth Group Limited (Minth or the Company), a leading auto parts manufacturer to set up electric vehicle (EV) battery housing production facilities in Serbia and Poland (the Project).
